# DayFlow — Smart Business Assistant

DayFlow is a smart business intelligence and operations assistant engineered for entrepreneurs, startups, and SMEs. It connects directly to popular database platforms, sheets, and custom data sources, delivering real-time insights, automatic digests, and action execution directly through instant messaging applications (WhatsApp and Telegram).

## Core Capabilities
- **Direct Messaging Integration**: Query, update, and manage your business databases from WhatsApp and Telegram.
- **Unified Data Connectors**: Supports Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, Supabase, and Custom JSON REST APIs.
- **Automated Reporting digests**: Automatically schedules and runs Morning, Evening, and Monthly PDF summary reports of business KPIs.
- **Model Routing Chain**: Employs an intelligent multi-model routing layer ensuring 100% service availability and uptime.
- **Enterprise-Grade Security**: Restrict access to designated phone numbers/accounts with end-to-end data encryption.

## Pricing Plans
- **Free Trial**: 7-day access to test integrations on WhatsApp & Telegram.
- **Starter ($19/month)**: 1 active workspace, WhatsApp + Telegram integration, Notion & Sheets connectors, 100 queries/month.
- **Pro ($49/month)**: 3 active workspaces, custom API/Supabase connectors, unlimited queries, PDF digests, priority model routing.
- **Enterprise (Custom)**: Custom SLA, dedicated server instance, white-labeled solution, on-premise connector hosting.

## Onboarding & Integration Details
To set up DayFlow for your business, complete the following steps:
1. Connect your databases or APIs on the DayFlow Console.
2. Select your primary interface (WhatsApp, Telegram, or both).
3. Set your custom triggers (e.g. morning reports, low-inventory alerts).
4. Invite your team members directly via WhatsApp/Telegram commands.

For live demonstrations and interactive sandboxes, refer to `/demo`.
For pricing information, refer to `/pricing`.
